title: not for those who follow bedding cleanliness recommendations
text:
not for those who follow bedding cleanliness recommendations. I purchased this product because the description states that it is machine washable in a large capacity washing machine.
The product itself was comfortable and fit well.
But...it did not make it through one wash on the gentlest cycle. The washing machine had ample room for this product, but it came out ruined after being washed.
